Your holdings: SOXL (-52.46%) and SPAL (-40.1%) are deep in the red and leveraged; margin amplifies these drops. SMH (-11.72%) and QQQI (-3.58%) also need attention as they are still down and flagged for trimming.

Watch: Keep an eye on broader economic data for signs of consumer resilience or further weakness. Also, watch for any specific news impacting the semiconductor sector.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged, underwater positions and respecting your stops in a cautious market.
plays: Address your leveraged positions, SOXL (-52.46%) and SPAL (-40.1%); their deep drawdowns on margin demand urgent stop review.
